description: Onboarding window (Task 10): 3-step first-run. Listens to engine-ready/engine-error/mic-level/stream-text/practice-result (core:event:allow-listen). core:app:default mirrors settings.json (getVersion in error copy is plausible). opener:allow-open-url scoped to the model HuggingFace repos (the model-name links open the model page in the system browser). Custom #[tauri::command]s (complete_onboarding, set_onboarding_practice, onboarding_select_model) are allowed from all windows by default.
